title: Travel Portals: The Easy Button, With Fine Print
caption:
A portal should earn your booking. Use it for a usable credit, worthwhile extra rewards or a points redemption you accept—otherwise, prefer direct.

Have Bilt Palladium? Its hotel credit gives you a reason to check Bilt Travel. Compare the same room or flight, cancellation terms and total price before counting the value. Paying with points changes the units—it does not rescue a bad price.

The catch: another party is involved in the booking. Check who handles changes and refunds, then confirm your reservation with the airline or hotel.

What would make that extra work worth it for you?
